shared.tagline.en: Know the wait before you walk in.
shared.tagline.text: Bíodh an fanacht ar eolas agat sula dtéann tú isteach.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Neamhspleách agus gan nasc le Uber Eats, Deliveroo ná Just Eat.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Gan tuairiscí úra? Féadfaidh PickupRadar {likelyFast} nó {likelySlow} a thaispeáint:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): amanna fanachta ag bailiú do thiománaithe sa Ríocht Aontaithe

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Féach cé chomh fada is a fhanann tiománaithe i mbialanna agus i siopaí sula dtéann tú isteach. Do thiománaithe Uber Eats, Deliveroo agus Just Eat sa Ríocht Aontaithe. Gan clárú.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Bíodh an fanacht ar eolas agat sula dtéann tú isteach.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: An seachadann tú do Uber Eats, Deliveroo nó Just Eat? Féach fanachtaí úra ag pointí bailithe i mbialanna agus i siopaí. Seachain fanacht fhada. Tapáil {reportWait} agus tuill {radarPoints}. Gan clárú.

home.hero.try.text: Bain triail as le sonraí fíor

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Anois i Milton Keynes. London ina dhiaidh sin.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Tá na haipeanna iPhone agus Android ag teacht go luath.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Sampla de scáileán baile PickupRadar leis an gcluaisín {nearby} oscailte. Tá pointí bailithe daite de réir na fanachta

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Scáileán samplach: fanachtaí samplacha, ní tuairiscí beo ó thiománaithe

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Scáileán samplach. Is amanna fanachta samplacha iad seo, ní tuairiscí beo. {live} le sonraí fíor.

home.example.live.text: Bain triail as an réamhamharc beo

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Úsáid {nearby} chun pointí bailithe gar duit a aimsiú nuair a bhíonn an suíomh casta air. Úsáid {fast} agus {slow} chun fanachtaí agus meastacháin a sheiceáil.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Bain triail as ainm, ceantar nó cód poist, mar shampla KFC nó Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Osclaíonn an scáileán {reportWait}. Roghnaigh am fanachta. Ní sheoltar aon rud.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in
home.signals.title.text: Cad is féidir leat a fheiceáil sula dtéann tú isteach

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Feiceann tú na lipéid chéanna san aip. Is tiománaithe a thuairiscíonn iad, ní na haipeanna seachadta.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Roghnaíonn tiománaithe am fanachta. Feiceann tú an fanacht reatha agus cé mhéad tiománaí a thuairiscigh í le 2 uair an chloig anuas.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Ní thaispeántar é ach nuair nach bhfuil tuairiscí úra ann. Is meastacháin iad, ní tuairiscí beo.

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Tapálann tiománaithe {reportProblem} chun é seo a thuairisciú. Feiceann tú an tuairisc sula dtiomáineann tú ann.

home.signals.missing.title.text: Pointí bailithe atá in easnamh nó mícheart

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Trí chéim éasca. Tógann tuairisciú cúpla soicind.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Gan phasfhocal. Tugann an aip próifíl Radar duit go huathoibríoch. Ní gá duit clárú.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Aimsigh an pointe bailithe. Féach an fanacht reatha, nó {likelyFast} nó {likelySlow} mura bhfuil tuairiscí úra ann.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Tar éis duit an t-ordú a bhailiú, tapáil {reportWait}. Tógann sé soicindí. Cabhraíonn do thuairisc le tiománaithe eile, agus tuilleann tú {radarPoints}.

home.points.note.text: {soon} Ní féidir leat {radarPoints} a fhuascailt fós.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Pointe bailithe oiriúnach gar duit gan fanacht le déanaí agus gan {likelyFast} ná {likelySlow}. Faigheann tú 15 RP as an tuairisc in ionad 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Seo cathracha na Ríochta Aontaithe san aip. Nach bhfuil do chathair le fáil? Iarr í san aip. Nó tapáil {notify} ar chathair atá {comingSoon}. Seolfaimid ríomhphost nuair a bheidh sí beo.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app
home.trust.title.text: Ní cuid d’aon aip seachadta é

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: Tá PickupRadar neamhspleách. Ní cuid de Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat ná aon aip seachadta eile é. Ní úsáideann sé do chuntais leo choíche.

home.trust.loginLead.text: Gan logáil isteach in aipeanna seachadta.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Ní iarrann muid ainm úsáideora ná pasfhocal Uber Eats, Deliveroo ná Just Eat choíche.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Gan ainmneacha, seoltaí ná uimhreacha ordaithe.

home.faq.account.q.text: An bhfuil cuntas ag teastáil uaim?

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Níl. Tugann an aip próifíl Radar duit go huathoibríoch. Is féidir leat fanachtaí a thuairisciú láithreach. Chun do {radarPoints} a chosaint, cuir do ríomhphost leis níos déanaí. Gan phasfhocal. Seolann an aip cód 6 dhigit chugat trí ríomhphost.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?
home.faq.download.q.text: Cathain is féidir liom an aip a íoslódáil?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Tá na haipeanna iPhone agus Android ag teacht go luath. Go dtí sin, taispeánann an {preview} pointí bailithe agus fanachtaí fíor i Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Gan rianú sa chúlra. Úsáideann an aip do shuíomh agus tú á húsáid, chun pointí bailithe in aice láimhe a thaispeáint agus chun a sheiceáil go bhfuil tú ag pointe bailithe agus tú ag tuairisciú. Ní iarrann an suíomh suíomh ach má roghnaíonn tú é a úsáid. Léigh an {privacy} le haghaidh tuilleadh.

app.meta.title.text: Réamhamharc beo ar an aip — PickupRadar

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Bain triail as aip PickupRadar le sonraí fíor ó Milton Keynes. Féach timpeall, cuardaigh pointí bailithe agus féach an scáileán tuairisce.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Seo PickupRadar le sonraí fíor ó Milton Keynes. Féach timpeall. Cuardaigh pointe bailithe agus oscail é. Ní sheoltar aon rud a dtapálann tú air anseo. Ní féidir leat tuairisciú ach san aip mhóibíleach.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Réamhamharc iomlán ar aip PickupRadar le sonraí fíor ó Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Cabhair le PickupRadar: déan teagmháil leis an tacaíocht, tuairiscigh fadhb ag pointe bailithe, agus faigh freagraí faoi do phróifíl Radar, {radarPoints} agus do chuntas a scriosadh.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Cabhair uait? Seol ríomhphost chugainn faoin aip, pointe bailithe, do {radarPoints} nó do phríobháideachas.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Seol ríomhphost chugainn le haghaidh cabhrach, smaointe, fadhbanna ag pointí bailithe nó ceisteanna príobháideachais:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Do litreacha amháin. Is é an ríomhphost an bealach is tapúla lenár dteagmháil a dhéanamh.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:
support.include.body.text: Má thuairiscíonn tú fadhb, inis dúinn:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: An ceantar nó an cód poist, má tá sé ar eolas agat

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Múnla do ghutháin, má tá fadhb ag an aip

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: Tugann an aip próifíl Radar duit go huathoibríoch. Ní gá duit logáil isteach chun PickupRadar a úsáid ná {radarPoints} a thuilleamh. Tá sé roghnach ríomhphost a chur leis. Cosnaíonn sé do {radarPoints} má athraíonn tú nó má athshocraíonn tú an fón. Gan phasfhocal. Seolann an aip cód 6 dhigit chugat trí ríomhphost.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Tuilleann tú {radarPoints} as tuairiscí fanachta bailí ({waitRp}, nó {neededRp} nuair a deir sé {reportNeeded}), bónas don chéad tuairisc ({firstRp}) agus pointí bailithe a cheadaímid ({approvedRp}). Is féidir leat tiománaí a thabhairt cuireadh ó {profile}. Teastaíonn cuntais Radar chosanta ón mbeirt agaibh (cuir ríomhphost leis). Cuireann do chara do chód isteach roimh an gcéad tuairisc fanachta bhailí. Nuair a dhéanann do chara 3 thuairisc fanachta bhailí, ar a laghad ar 2 lá éagsúil (am UTC), ag 2 phointe bailithe éagsúla, faigheann gach duine agaibh {referralRp}. {rewards} Ní féidir leat {radarPoints} a fhuascailt fós.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: Tá {messages} ag {profile}: fógraí, foláirimh agus teachtaireachtaí pearsanta do do chathair nó do phróifíl Radar. Seans nach dtaispeánfar teachtaireachtaí sean nó bainte a thuilleadh.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Scrios do chuntas san aip: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Nó seol ríomhphost chuig {email}. Mura bhfuil ríomhphost curtha leis agat, taispeánann an aip {deleteProfile}. Féach an leathanach {page} le haghaidh na gcéimeanna.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Pointe bailithe in easnamh? Tapáil {suggest} san aip. Ceann mícheart? Tapáil {reportProblem}. Nó seol ríomhphost chugainn agus seiceálfaimid é.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: Ní nascann PickupRadar le do chuntais Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat ná aipeanna seachadta eile. Ní iarrann muid logáil isteach, pasfhocail, sonraí cuntais, sonraí custaiméirí ná sonraí ordaithe choíche. Ní roinneann tiománaithe ach tuairiscí bailithe, mar amanna fanachta agus fadhbanna ag pointí bailithe.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Bain triail as PickupRadar sula seoltar an aip.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Taispeánann an réamhamharc beo pointí bailithe agus fanachtaí fíor i Milton Keynes. Níl tuairisciú ná {radarPoints} ach san aip mhóibíleach.

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.
notfound.meta.description.text: Níl an leathanach sin ar shuíomh PickupRadar.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.
notfound.title.text: Tá an leathanach seo as an radar.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Níl an seoladh sin ar shuíomh PickupRadar. Tá na leathanaigh seo ann:

privacy.notice.en: The summary and section headings are translated. The full privacy policy is in English, which is the official version.
privacy.notice.text: Tá an achoimre agus ceannteidil na rannóg aistrithe. Tá an beartas príobháideachais iomlán i mBéarla, agus is é an leagan Béarla an leagan oifigiúil.

privacy.h.collect.en: Information we collect and how we use it
privacy.h.collect.text: Cén fhaisnéis a bhailímid agus conas a úsáidimid í

privacy.sum.what.en: PickupRadar helps delivery drivers see and report pickup wait times and venue problems.
privacy.sum.what.text: Cabhraíonn PickupRadar le tiománaithe seachadta amanna feithimh bailiúcháin agus fadhbanna ionad a fheiceáil agus a thuairisciú.

privacy.sum.account.en: You can browse without creating an account. The app creates an anonymous Radar profile for your phone, and an email account is optional.
privacy.sum.account.text: Is féidir leat brabhsáil gan chuntas. Cruthaíonn an aip próifíl Radar gan ainm do d'fhón, agus is roghnach cuntas ríomhphoist.

privacy.sum.location.en: If you allow location, the app uses it while you are using it: to sort nearby pickup points, detect your city and check that you are at a venue when you submit a live report. We do not save your location with your reports.
privacy.sum.location.text: Má cheadaíonn tú suíomh, ní úsáideann an aip é ach fad atá tú á húsáid: chun pointí bailiúcháin in aice láimhe a shórtáil, do chathair a aithint agus a sheiceáil go bhfuil tú ag an ionad nuair a sheolann tú tuairisc bheo. Ní shábhálaimid do shuíomh le do thuairiscí.

privacy.sum.saved.en: Your saved pickup points stay on your phone.
privacy.sum.saved.text: Fanann na pointí bailiúcháin a shábháil tú ar d'fhón.

privacy.sum.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal information and the app contains no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.sum.noSale.text: Ní dhíolaimid d'fhaisnéis phearsanta, agus níl aon rianaire fógraíochta ná anailísíochta san aip.

privacy.sum.delete.en: You can delete your Radar profile or account in the app, or ask us by email. See {link}.
privacy.sum.delete.text: Is féidir leat do phróifíl Radar nó do chuntas a scriosadh san aip, nó ríomhphost a sheoladh chugainn á iarraidh. Féach {link}.

delete.meta.title.en: Delete your account or data — PickupRadar
delete.meta.title.text: Scrios do chuntas nó do shonraí — PickupRadar

delete.meta.description.en: How to delete your PickupRadar account, Radar profile and associated data, including without the app.
delete.meta.description.text: Conas do chuntas PickupRadar, do phróifíl Radar agus sonraí gaolmhara a scriosadh, fiú gan an aip.

delete.h1.text: Scrios do chuntas nó do shonraí

delete.lead.en: This page explains how to delete your PickupRadar account, your Radar profile and the data linked to them, including if you no longer have the app. PickupRadar is developed by Hamza Khan.
delete.lead.text: Míníonn an leathanach seo conas do chuntas PickupRadar, do phróifíl Radar agus na sonraí atá nasctha leo a scriosadh, fiú mura bhfuil an aip agat a thuilleadh. Is é Hamza Khan a d'fhorbair PickupRadar.

delete.app.step2.en: Tap {profile} at the bottom of the Home screen.
delete.app.step2.text: Tapáil {profile} ag bun an scáileáin bhaile.

delete.app.step3.en: Scroll down and tap {deleteAccount} if you protected your RadarPoints with your email, or {deleteProfile} if you did not.
delete.app.step3.text: Scrollaigh síos agus tapáil {deleteAccount} má chosain tú do RadarPoints le ríomhphost, nó {deleteProfile} mura ndearna.

delete.app.after.en: Deletion starts straight away. Afterwards, the app starts a new anonymous Radar profile on your phone.
delete.app.after.text: Tosaíonn an scriosadh láithreach. Ina dhiaidh sin tosaíonn an aip próifíl Radar nua gan ainm ar d'fhón.

delete.email.title.en: Ask us to delete your email account
delete.email.title.text: Iarr orainn do chuntas ríomhphoist a scriosadh

delete.email.intro.en: If you protected your RadarPoints with your email address and cannot use the app:
delete.email.intro.text: Má chosain tú do RadarPoints le seoladh ríomhphoist agus nach féidir leat an aip a úsáid:

delete.email.step1.text: Seol ríomhphost chuig {email} {from}, leis an ábhar “{subject}”.

delete.email.from.en: from the email address on your PickupRadar account
delete.email.from.text: ón seoladh ríomhphoist atá ar do chuntas PickupRadar

delete.email.step2.en: We will reply to that address to confirm the request before deleting anything.
delete.email.step2.text: Freagróimid an seoladh sin chun an t-iarratas a dheimhniú sula scriosfaimid aon rud.

delete.email.other.en: If you write from a different address, we will need to confirm that you control the account’s email address. We will never ask for a password or for a sign-in code. Do not send us your code.
delete.email.other.text: Má scríobhann tú ó sheoladh eile, beidh orainn a dheimhniú go bhfuil smacht agat ar sheoladh ríomhphoist an chuntais. Ní iarrfaimid pasfhocal ná cód síniú isteach go deo. Ná seol do chód chugainn.

delete.anon.p1.en: If you never added an email address, your Radar profile is linked only to a random ID stored in the app on your phone. The easiest way to delete it is in the app, using the steps above.
delete.anon.p1.text: Mura ndearna tú seoladh ríomhphoist a chur leis riamh, níl do phróifíl Radar nasctha ach le ID randamach atá sábháilte san aip ar d'fhón. Is é an bealach is éasca chun í a scriosadh ná san aip, leis na céimeanna thuas.

delete.anon.p2.en: Deleting the app removes that ID from your phone, but it does {not} delete the records on our servers.
delete.anon.p2.text: Baintear an ID sin de d'fhón nuair a scriostar an aip, ach {not} taifid ar ár bhfreastalaithe.

delete.anon.p3.en: Ownership of an anonymous profile can only be proven from the phone it was created on, using the random ID and secret code stored in the app. Details such as a Radar name, a city or the dates you used the app can’t prove that a profile is yours, because other people could know them. So if you no longer have the app, we may not be able to delete an anonymous profile. You can still email {email} and we will explain what we can do.
delete.anon.p3.text: Ní féidir úinéireacht próifíle gan ainm a chruthú ach ón bhfón ar a cruthaíodh í, ag úsáid an ID randamaigh agus an chóid rúnda atá sábháilte san aip. Ní chruthaíonn sonraí ar nós ainm Radar, cathair nó dátaí úsáide na haipe gur leatsa an phróifíl, mar d'fhéadfadh daoine eile iad a bheith ar eolas acu freisin. Mar sin, mura bhfuil an aip agat a thuilleadh, b'fhéidir nach mbeimid in ann próifíl gan ainm a scriosadh. Is féidir leat ríomhphost a sheoladh chuig {email} mar sin féin agus míneoimid cad is féidir linn a dhéanamh.

delete.alerts.body.en: You can withdraw a launch alert in the app, or email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete the sign-ups for that address. Launch-alert emails are also deleted automatically, as explained in our {privacy}.
delete.alerts.body.text: Is féidir leat foláireamh seolta a tharraingt siar san aip, nó ríomhphost a sheoladh chugainn ón seoladh lenar chláraigh tú agus scriosfaimid na clárúcháin don seoladh sin. Scriostar ríomhphoist foláirimh seolta go huathoibríoch freisin, mar a mhíníonn ár {privacy}.

delete.deleted.profile.en: Your Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints and contribution history
delete.deleted.profile.text: Do phróifíl Radar, d'ainm Radar, do RadarPoints agus do stair rannpháirtíochta

delete.deleted.email.en: Your email sign-in, if you had an email account

delete.deleted.alerts.en: City launch alert sign-ups linked to your profile or phone
delete.deleted.alerts.text: Clárúcháin foláirimh seolta atá nasctha le do phróifíl nó le d'fhón

delete.deleted.notes.en: Notes on the problem reports, status reports and venue suggestions linked to your profile
delete.deleted.notes.text: Nótaí ar thuairiscí fadhbanna, tuairiscí stádais agus moltaí ionad atá nasctha le do phróifíl

delete.kept.reports.en: {lead}, such as wait times, venue status reports and tags, and venue suggestions: the device ID on the records linked to your profile is replaced with a random value, so they are no longer connected to your profile in our database. They still contain details such as the venue and time, so they are de-identified rather than fully anonymous. They may be kept so they can still help other drivers.
delete.kept.reports.text: {lead}, mar shampla amanna feithimh, tuairiscí stádais agus clibeanna ionad, agus moltaí ionad: cuirtear luach randamach in ionad an ID gléis i dtaifid atá nasctha le do phróifíl, ionas nach bhfuil siad nasctha le do phróifíl inár mbunachar sonraí a thuilleadh. Tá sonraí fós iontu ar nós ionad agus am, mar sin tá siad díshainaitheanta, ní go hiomlán gan ainm. Féadfar iad a choinneáil ionas go leanfaidh siad ag cabhrú le tiománaithe eile.
